dogecoin.text:
One of the richest and most innovative dudes in the world says $DOGE is legit and it immediately dumps. 

This is your annual reminder that there's like 5 people who own 80% of $DOGE and they decide what the price does.

8/ Doge coin was built off the proof of work process made popular by bitcoin, but its infinite supply distribution fits with Elon's fundamental beliefs. I believe Elon understands the importance of POW and sees a popular asset he can heavily influence the development of.
